title: Touching craft pieces with Garry Nolan
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Touching craft pieces with Garry Nolan, about 2020s at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Like I've seen pieces of a craft. I've been with Garry Nolan. I don't know if they're real pieces of a craft, but like they seem.

plain: Jesse Michels says that in the 2020s he has seen what were presented as pieces of a craft, an unexplained flying object, while he was with Garry Nolan, a scientist who studies such materials. Michels tells this himself and is careful about it: he says he does not know if they are real pieces of a craft, only that they seem to be. If they were, it would mean physical leftovers of such objects are in private hands.
